notes.title: Small Bugfixes
notes.notes:
Some issues were reported and so I fixed them.

Fullscreen Mode is now persistent

As you can toggle between fullscreen and windowed mode by pressing Alt+Enter, this changes were not saved between gaming sessions. It's now a persistent setting and the game will start in whatever mode it was before.

Camera Tilt not working after starting the game

A changed cameratilt was not properly recognized after the start of the game. This is now fixed and the game applies this setting after startup correctly.


Hopefully you enjoy the game and let me know about any issues you experience
